title: Withdrawal Request Exceeding Free Margin
precondition: Sub-account equity = $10,000; Used margin = $8,000; Free margin = $2,000.
expected_result: System blocks withdrawal: 'Requested amount ($4,000) exceeds available free margin ($2,000)'; suggests max allowable withdrawal.
actual_result: Withdrawal requests exceeding free margin are rejected with error: 'Requested amount exceeds available free margin'.
